title: Momordicine I Mediates Lipid-Lowering Effects of Momordica Charantia L. Triterpenoid Saponins via TFEB-Driven Lysosomal Biogenesis.
authors: Bai, Juan; Zhu, Zixian; Pan, Beibei; Yang, Zihan; Dai, Chengyu; Huang, Shiting; Zhu, Ying; Zhao, Yansheng; Zhang, Na; Xiao, Xiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苦瓜皂苷单体Momordicine I通过TFEB介导溶酶体生物发生促进脂自噬的降脂机制，核心是代谢调控而非蛋白质-DNA互作，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Bitter melon saponin extract (BMSE) is well-known to exhibit anti-obesity activity. The network pharmacology study in our previous studies has confirmed that momordicine I was the core triterpenoid compound responsible for the lipid-lowering effects of BMSE, and lipophagy was predicted as the potential mechanism. However, the exact regulatory effects of momordicine I or BMSE on the whole autophagic flux and processes remained unknown. The present study aimed to investigate the specific molecular mechanisms of regulating lipophagy by momordicine I or BMSE in vivo and in vitro. Results demonstrated that both BMSE and momordicine I significantly alleviated lipid accumulation in HepG2 cells and C. elegans, with momordicine I showing a relatively superior effect. Furthermore, treatment with BMSE and momordicine I promoted the formation of autophagosomes, the autophagosomes-lysosome fusions, and autolysosome degradation in HepG2 cells, thereby enhancing autophagic flux. In addition, siRNA interferences and TFEB-deficient C. elegans mutants verified TFEB-mediated lysosomal biogenesis played an essential role in BMSE's effects on lipophagy. Moreover, molecular docking experiments further confirmed that momordicine I could combine TFEB's upstream regulators, AMPK/mTOR, thereby enhancing TFEB nuclear translocation. In summary, BMSE and momordicine I were able to activate the TFEB-mediated lysosomal biogenesis pathway to promote lipophagy and alleviate lipid accumulation.
abstract_zh: 苦瓜皂苷提取物（BMSE）已知具有抗肥胖活性。我们前期研究中的网络药理学分析已确认，momordicine I 是负责 BMSE 降脂作用的核心三萜类化合物，并预测脂自噬（lipophagy）为其潜在机制。然而，momordicine I 或 BMSE 对整个自噬流及过程的精确调控作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨 momordicine I 或 BMSE 在体内和体外调节脂自噬的具体分子机制。结果表明，BMSE 和 momordicine I 均显著减轻了 HepG2 细胞和秀丽隐杆线虫（C. elegans）中的脂质积累，其中 momordicine I 表现出相对更优的效果。此外，BMSE 和 momordicine I 处理促进了 HepG2 细胞中自噬体的形成、自噬体-溶酶体融合及自噬溶酶体降解，从而增强了自噬流。进一步地，siRNA 干扰和 TFEB 缺陷的线虫突变体验证了 TFEB 介导的溶酶体生物发生（lysosomal biogenesis）在 BMSE 对脂自噬作用中发挥关键作用。此外，分子对接实验进一步证实，momordicine I 能与 TFEB 的上游调控因子 AMPK/mTOR 结合，从而增强 TFEB 核转位。总之，BMSE 和 momordicine I 能够激活 TFEB 介导的溶酶体生物发生通路，以促进脂自噬并减轻脂质积累。
